dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, how old do you have to be to vote in Thailand?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈhaʊ ˈoʊld duː juː ˈhæf tə bi tə ˈvoʊt ɪn ˈtaɪlænd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Eighteen. It's the same in the US, isn't it?
dialogue.reading: ˌeɪˈtiːn. ɪts ðə ˈseɪm ɪn ðə ˌjuːˈɛs, ˈɪzənt ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. But some people want to make the voting age sixteen. Are you in favor of that?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. bʌt sʌm ˈpiːpəl ˈwɑːnt tə ˈmeɪk ðə ˈvoʊtɪŋ ˌeɪdʒ ˌsɪkˈstiːn. ər juː ɪn ˈfeɪvər əv ˈðæt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, I'm in favor of changing it. Elections decide young people's future, too.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪm ɪn ˈfeɪvər əv ˈtʃeɪndʒɪŋ ɪt. ɪˈlɛkʃənz dɪˈsaɪd ˈjʌŋ ˈpiːpəlz ˈfjuːtʃər, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: But many people are against giving teenagers the vote. They say teenagers don't know enough about politics.
dialogue.reading: bʌt ˈmɛni ˈpiːpəl ər əˈɡɛnst ˈɡɪvɪŋ ˈtiːneɪdʒərz ðə ˈvoʊt. ðeɪ ˈseɪ ˈtiːneɪdʒərz ˈdoʊnt ˈnoʊ ɪˈnʌf əˈbaʊt ˈpɑːlətɪks.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Lots of adults don't know much about politics, either!
dialogue.reading: ˈlɑːts əv əˈdʌlts ˈdoʊnt ˈnoʊ ˈmʌtʃ əˈbaʊt ˈpɑːlətɪks, ˈiːðər!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Ha! That's true. Did you vote in the last election?
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! ðæts ˈtruː. dɪd juː ˈvoʊt ɪn ðə ˈlæst ɪˈlɛkʃən?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, it was my first time. I was so excited.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪt wʌz maɪ ˈfɜːrst ˈtaɪm. aɪ wʌz soʊ ɪkˈsaɪtɪd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And what do you think of politicians in Thailand?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwʌt duː juː ˈθɪŋk əv ˌpɑːləˈtɪʃənz ɪn ˈtaɪlænd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Some are good, and some aren't. I'm against politicians making promises they can't keep.
dialogue.reading: sʌm ər ˈɡʊd, ənd sʌm ˈɑːrnt. aɪm əˈɡɛnst ˌpɑːləˈtɪʃənz ˈmeɪkɪŋ ˈprɑːmɪsɪz ðeɪ ˈkænt ˈkiːp.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I agree. Are you in favor of voting online?
dialogue.reading: aɪ əˈɡriː. ər juː ɪn ˈfeɪvər əv ˈvoʊtɪŋ ˌɑːnˈlaɪn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not yet. I'm in favor of making voting easier, but I'm against using a system that isn't safe.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈjɛt. aɪm ɪn ˈfeɪvər əv ˈmeɪkɪŋ ˈvoʊtɪŋ ˈiːziər, bʌt aɪm əˈɡɛnst ˈjuːzɪŋ ə ˈsɪstəm ðæt ˈɪzənt ˈseɪf.
